Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS)

The Department of Health and Human Services Victoria website has closed.

The Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) Victoria closed on 1 February 2021.

Its responsibilities moved to the Department of Families, Fairness and Housing (DFFH) and the Department of Health.

Department of Families, Fairness and Housing

For information about housing, child protection, disability, ageing and carers, prevention of family violence, women, veterans, youth and LGBTIQA+ equality.

Department of Health

For information about acute health services, public health, primary, community and dental health, health regulation, mental health, drug services, ageing, aged and home care.

Reviewed 17 January 2025
